transportNote: No Ethernet cables were available. The evaluated data plane used two logical USB RNDIS gadget functions on the physically separate Cat2 instead of eth0/eth1. Bridge membership, PID1 lease, authorization, and selected faults ran on the real Cat2. Ethernet PHY, speed/duplex, VLAN, and link-flap items are NOT_RUN. See protocol/TRANSPORT-SUBSTITUTION.md.

cat2.serverTransport: USB RNDIS gadget function rndis.usb1 (host MAC 02:11:11:11:11:01)
cat2.uplinkTransport: USB RNDIS gadget function rndis.usb2 (host MAC 02:22:22:22:22:01)
cat2.managementChannel: USB RNDIS rndis.gs0 (logically outside agbr0 but sharing the composite gadget, controller, cable, and re-enumeration event)
cat2.ethernetPortsRole: NOT_USED this run (no cables); available for a future Ethernet-transport replication

protectedHost.implementation: single-path network namespace 'victim' on the trusted operator laptop; the namespace contains only agvictim0 and does not represent whole-laptop root compromise
protectedHost.upstreamInterface: aguplink0 (02:22:22:22:22:01) on the laptop host, local-only upstream endpoint
protectedHost.upstreamGateway: 10.99.0.1 (local laptop endpoint; no host forwarding or NAT)

upstream.internetProbe: not used; local upstream 10.99.0.1 is the availability oracle
